#1140 removed #1125's pattern 1a from Core, Classic, Classic+ and Meditative. None. Follows #1125 and #1140. Siblings: #2846 to #2851.

medium: card files, but deletion only, within one crate and fewer than 40 files, under a rule #1140 already set.

No priority
